name: test-merchant-site
description: Test merchant e-commerce site for the GurzuVTO 'Custom Pull' connector. Exposes a token-protected, paginated catalog in the merchant's OWN field shape (not GurzuVTO's), backed by Postgres, populated from real meesa.shop data.

scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "git hooks installed (.githooks)"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:repo && npm run test:sanitize && npm run smoke && npm run audit && npm run test:endpoints && npm run test:storefront && npm run test:parity
